reviewItem.question: For "The `cilium-dbg status --verbose` command health data may now show health reported on a non-leaf component under a leaf named `reporter`. Health data tree…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: The cilium-dbg status --verbose command output format changed: health data from non-leaf components now appears under a reporter leaf, and health data tree branches are now sorted by fully qualified health status identifier.
